The Packages of the Toolkit

Source: R/attach.R
statmodels7_packages.Rd

The names of the packages this one installs and attaches.

Usage

statmodels7_packages()

Value

A character vector of package names, sorted.

Details

The list is read from the Imports field of this package's own DESCRIPTION, keeping the entries whose names end in 7, which is the toolkit's naming convention. Reading it rather than writing it out keeps one enumeration: a member added to Imports is a member here, and the two cannot disagree.

S7 is excluded, and it is the one name the convention cannot tell apart on its own: its 7 counts R's object systems and not this toolkit's, and it is what every member is built on rather than a member. Declaring it in Imports, which R CMD check requires because the code says S7:: throughout, therefore made it report as a ninth package until this line existed.

See also

statmodels7_versions, statmodels7_conflicts

Examples

statmodels7_packages()
#> [1] "basis7"         "distributions7" "linkfunctions7" "modelterms7"   
#> [5] "numericals7"    "optimizers7"    "parameters7"    "penalties7"
